verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas Engine is published as the `playcanvas` npm package (npm install playcanvas, verified version 2.22.2, 48k weekly downloads), ships as ESM/class-based scripts, and is explicitly documented for standalone use and integration with any JS framework, including React and Web Components wrappers as separate npm packages. Community confirms it can be used alongside other JS frameworks/toolchains. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation or independent confirmation of tree-shaking behavior/bundler-friendliness specifics beyond general ESM support.
